scripts.dev: concurrently -k -n API,WEB -c yellow,cyan "npm run dev -w @mentes-brillantes/api" "npm run dev -w @mentes-brillantes/web"
scripts.build: npm run build -w @mentes-brillantes/web && npm run build -w @mentes-brillantes/api
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck -w @mentes-brillantes/web && npm run typecheck -w @mentes-brillantes/api
scripts.test: npm run test -w @mentes-brillantes/api && npm run test -w @mentes-brillantes/web
